author: Developer Express Inc.
name: DevExpress ASP.NET Core Angular Reporting Project
description: A template for creating an ASP.NET Core Angular application with the DevExpress Web Document Viewer and/or End-User Report Designer. To start a project, specify the DevExpress NuGet Feed URL as a required feed parameter. Refer to https://nuget.devexpress.com/#feed-url and login to your account to obtain your Feed URL.

nuget-feed.description: Refer to https://nuget.devexpress.com/#feed-url and login to your account to obtain your Feed URL.

add-designer.description: Whether to add a web page that contains the Report Designer.

add-viewer.description: Whether to add a web page that contains the Document Viewer.

add-data-source.description: Whether to register a sample connection string to create SQL Data Sources in the Report and Data Source Wizards. This connection string is also used to register a predefined data source in the Report Designer.

AddJsonDataSourceService.description: Whether to register a sample data connection storage to create JSON Data Sources in the Report and Data Source Wizards.

AddObjectDataSourceProvider.description: Whether to register a sample data object to create Object Data Sources in the Report and Data Source Wizards.

EnableClientRichEdit.description: Whether to enable an advanced in-line editor for the Report Designer's RichText control.

framework.description: The target framework for the project.

choices.description: Default cache that stores objects directly in memory without serialization, optimized for frequent operations.
Implements database cache based on the XPO library, designed for multi-instance applications to prevent cache data loss.
Configures the reporting engine to store documents generated by reports on disk instead of in memory.
Enables cache as external service that uses ASP.NET Core distributed caching mechanism and can be shared by multiple application servers.
Configures the application to use Azure caching services.

DocumentStorage.description: Select the storage type to cache documents that the report creates.
